name: Inherent structures and stability
meaning: Find mechanically stable energy minima A and B and identify positive non-rigid Hessian eigenvalues.
flow: Atomic coordinates, potential energy, Hessian eigenvalues → stable reference configurations.

name: Forward and reverse activation barriers
latex:
\Delta E^{\ddagger}_{A\to B}=U(\mathbf r_S)-U(\mathbf r_A),\qquad
\Delta E^{\ddagger}_{B\to A}=U(\mathbf r_S)-U(\mathbf r_B).
meaning: Compare saddle energy with initial and final minimum energies. One saddle can imply different forward and reverse barriers.
flow: Potential energy landscape and saddle points → directional barriers.

name: Thermally activated event rate
latex:
k_{ae}(\bm\sigma,T,\mathbf z_a)=\nu_{ae}(\bm\sigma,T,\mathbf z_a)
 \exp\!\left[-\frac{\Delta G^\ddagger_{ae}(\bm\sigma,T,\mathbf z_a)}{k_{\mathrm B}T}\right],
meaning: Convert free-energy barriers and attempt frequencies into rates at temperature and stress.
flow: Free-energy barriers, prefactors, stress, temperature → physically weighted transition rates.

name: Athermal instability and fold scaling
latex:
\lambda_{\min}^{+}\!\big(\mathbf H(\gamma)\big)\to0^+,\qquad
 \partial_{\mathbf r}U(\mathbf r,\gamma)=0,\qquad
 \Delta E^\ddagger\sim C(\gamma_c-\gamma)^{3/2}\quad\text{(generic fold, if applicable)}.
meaning: Track loss of local stability as strain increases. A 3/2 barrier scaling can arise near a generic fold instability; it is not universal.
flow: Hessian softening and imposed strain → athermal onset / possible fold scaling.

name: Participation weights and local observables
latex:
w_i=\frac{|\Delta\mathbf r_i|^4}{\sum_j|\Delta\mathbf r_j|^4},\qquad
 N_{\mathrm{part}}=\left(\sum_i w_i^2\right)^{-1},\qquad
 \langle q\rangle_{\mathrm{LSE}}=\sum_iw_iq_i.
meaning: Weight atom-level displacements, estimate effective participation, and average event-local quantities.
flow: Atomic displacement field → coarse event core size and weighted descriptor.

name: Atomic event descriptor vector
latex:
\mathcal E_e=\big( A_e,B_e,S_e,\Delta E_e^{\ddagger,+},\Delta E_e^{\ddagger,-},
 \nu_e^\pm,\mathbf M_e,\mathbf Q_e,\ell_e,r_e,\mathbf z_e\big),
meaning: Bundle state identifiers, barriers, prefactors, mechanical moments and structural descriptors for a single event.
flow: Raw trajectories and sampled transitions → transferable event catalogue.

name: Plastic event moment and stress-biased barrier
latex:
\mathbf M_e=\int_{\Omega_e}\Delta\bm\varepsilon_e^p\,\dd V
 \simeq V_e\Delta\bm\varepsilon_e^p,\qquad
 \Delta G_e^\ddagger(\bm\sigma)\simeq\Delta G_e^\ddagger(\mathbf0)
 -\bm\sigma:\mathbf V_e^\ddagger+O(\|\bm\sigma\|^2),
meaning: Map a local plastic strain into a volume-integrated event moment and approximate how stress tilts an activation barrier.
flow: Event strain, core volume and stress → plastic moment and stress-sensitive barrier.

name: Master equation for state probabilities
latex:
\dot p_i=\sum_{j\ne i}\big(k_{j\to i}p_j-k_{i\to j}p_i\big),\qquad
 \sum_i p_i=1.
meaning: Balance incoming and outgoing probability currents between atomic states.
flow: Directed transition rates and state probabilities → evolving state population.

name: Kinetic Monte Carlo and waiting times
meaning: Aggregate active event rates, sample which event occurs and the next waiting time, and calculate occurrence probability.
flow: Event catalogue and rates → stochastic event selection and clock.

name: Detailed balance
latex: \frac{k_{i\to j}}{k_{j\to i}}=\exp[-\beta(G_j-G_i)]\quad\text{for equilibrium reversible transitions},\qquad\beta=(k_\mathrm BT)^{-1}.
meaning: Impose equilibrium reversibility when it is applicable through state free-energy differences.
flow: State free energies → constraints on forward/reverse transition rates.

name: Why mean-barrier averaging fails
latex:
\sum_e 
u_e e^{- eta\Delta G_e^\ddagger}
 
e \Big(\sum_e
u_e\Big)e^{- eta\avg{\Delta G^\ddagger}}.
meaning: Show that summing exponential rates differs from substituting an average barrier; rare low barriers can matter disproportionately.
flow: Barrier distributions → total kinetic activity, not mean-barrier approximation.

name: Stress sensitivity of transition rates
meaning: Differentiate logarithmic rates with respect to a stress component, separating prefactor response and barrier response.
flow: Stress-dependent kinetics → rate sensitivity tensor components.

name: Accessible events and extreme statistics
meaning: Count events statistically accessible over an observation time and estimate minimum-barrier extremes for independent samples.
flow: Observation window and barrier distribution → active-event count and extreme statistics.

name: Driving-to-relaxation timescale ratio
latex: \mathrm{De}_a=\frac{\dot\gamma}{\gamma_* K_a},
meaning: Compare the imposed strain rate with local relaxation activity; the quotient marks kinetic versus driving dominance.
flow: Macroscopic driving and event rates → dimensionless crossover indicator.

name: Mesoscale elastic redistribution
latex:
\delta\sigma_{ij}(\mathbf x)=\int_\Omega
 \mathcal G_{ijkl}(\mathbf x,\mathbf y;\mathcal B)\,
 \delta\varepsilon^p_{kl}(\mathbf y)\,\dd\mathbf y,
meaning: Use an elastic Green operator to propagate local plastic strain changes as a nonlocal stress redistribution.
flow: Localized plastic event → interacting mesoscale stress field.

name: Plastic events, renewal and equilibration
latex:
\bm\varepsilon^p_a\leftarrow\bm\varepsilon^p_a+\Delta\bm\varepsilon^p_e,\quad
 \mathbf z_a\leftarrow\mathcal R(\mathbf z_a,e),\quad
 \operatorname{div}\bm\sigma=\mathbf0,\quad
 \{k_{be}\}\leftarrow\{k_{be}(\bm\sigma_b,T,\mathbf z_b)\}.
meaning: After each plastic event, update plastic strain, structural variables, force equilibrium and all affected event rates.
flow: Event catalogue → history-dependent coupled event evolution.

name: Avalanche size statistics and finite-size scaling
latex: P(S;L)\sim S^{-\tau}\,f\!\left(\frac{S}{S_c(L)}\right),\qquad S_c(L)\sim L^{d_f},
meaning: Model a scale-dependent avalanche power law with cutoff that grows with system size.
flow: Burst sizes across system sizes → scaling exponents and collective behavior.

name: STZ populations and plastic strain rate
latex:
\begin{aligned}
\dot c_+&=-r_-c_++r_+c_-+\Gamma_+, &
 \dot c_-&=r_-c_+-r_+c_-+\Gamma_-,\\
 \dot{\bm\varepsilon}^{p}&=\frac{1}{V}\sum_e
 k_e(\bm\sigma,T,\mathbf z)\,\mathbf M_e
 \quad\longrightarrow\quad \mathcal F(\bm\sigma,T,\chi,c_+,c_-),\\
 \dot\chi&=\mathcal H(\bm\sigma:\dot{\bm\varepsilon}^{p},\chi,T)-
 \mathcal A(\chi,T)+\operatorname{div}(D_\chi\nabla\chi).
\end{aligned}
meaning: Evolve plus/minus STZ populations and relate weighted events to plastic strain rate; continuum closure adds constitutive assumptions.
flow: STZ populations and event moments → mesoscale plastic flow law.

name: Microscale-to-macroscale averages
latex:
\overline{\mathbf F}=\frac{1}{|\Omega_m|}\int_{\Omega_m}\mathbf F_m\,\dd V,
 \qquad
 \overline{\mathbf P}=\frac{1}{|\Omega_m|}\int_{\Omega_m}\mathbf P_m\,\dd V.
meaning: Average deformation gradient and first Piola stress across a representative volume element.
flow: Microscopic fields → macro deformation and macro stress.

name: Hill–Mandel power consistency
latex:
\overline{\mathbf P}:\delta\overline{\mathbf F}
 =\frac{1}{|\Omega_m|}\int_{\Omega_m}\mathbf P_m:\delta\mathbf F_m\,\dd V.
meaning: Require average micro-scale incremental power to equal corresponding macroscopic stress power.
flow: RVE response → energetically consistent scale transfer.

name: Incremental homogenized energy potential
latex:
\overline\Pi_{n+1}(\overline{\mathbf F},\overline{\mathbf q})
 =\frac{1}{|\Omega_m|}\inf_{\widetilde{\mathbf w},\mathbf q_m}
 \int_{\Omega_m}\!\big[\psi_m(\mathbf F_m,\mathbf q_m)+
 \mathcal D_m(\mathbf q_m,\mathbf q_m^{n})\big]\,\dd V.
meaning: Find homogenized incremental energy by minimizing micro energy and dissipation with respect to fluctuations and internal fields.
flow: Micro free energy + dissipation → effective incremental potential.

name: Macroscopic stress and tangent modulus
latex:
\overline{\mathbf P}=\frac{\partial\overline\Pi}{\partial\overline{\mathbf F}},\qquad
 \overline{\mathbb A}=\frac{\dd\overline{\mathbf P}}{\dd\overline{\mathbf F}}.
meaning: Differentiate the homogenized potential for stress and its consistent algorithmic tangent.
flow: Effective potential → macro stress and tangent stiffness.

name: Consistent tangent via Schur complement
meaning: Condense microscale fluctuation degrees of freedom to obtain a homogenized tangent via Schur complement.
flow: Coupled micro tangent blocks → effective macro tangent.

name: Thermodynamic dissipation inequality
latex:
\mathcal D=\mathbf P:\dot{\mathbf F}-\dot\psi-\eta\dot T
 -\frac{1}{T}\mathbf q\cdot\nabla T\ge0,
meaning: Enforce the second law through nonnegative mechanical-thermal dissipation.
flow: Stress, energy, temperature and heat flux → admissible constitutive behavior.

name: Fluctuation index and correlation length
meaning: Measure relative fluctuations as RVE size changes and extract a characteristic spatial correlation length.
flow: Field statistics → RVE adequacy and localization length estimates.

name: Finite-strain plastic flow rule
meaning: Represent finite-strain plastic flow by the plastic velocity gradient or a constitutive evolution function.
flow: Coarse event rates and orientations → finite-strain plastic kinematics.

name: Acoustic tensor and localization criterion
latex:
\mathbf Q(\mathbf n)=\mathbf n\cdot\mathbb C_{\mathrm{alg}}\cdot\mathbf n,
 \qquad\min_{\|\mathbf n\|=1}\det\mathbf Q(\mathbf n)\to0,
meaning: Check loss of ellipticity of the algorithmic acoustic tensor over possible band normals as a localization indicator.
flow: Continuum tangent → candidate strain-localization directions.

name: Phase-field plasticity/fracture energy
latex:
\mathcal E(\mathbf u,d,\mathbf q)=\int_\Omega\!
 \left[g(d)\psi_e^+(\mathbf F^e,\chi)+\psi_e^-(\mathbf F^e,\chi)
 +\psi_{\mathrm{hard}}(\mathbf q)
 +\frac{G_c(\mathbf q,T)}{2}\left(\frac{d^2}{\ell_d}+\ell_d|\nabla d|^2\right)\right]\dd V
 -W_{\mathrm{ext}},
meaning: Combine tensile/compressive elastic contributions, hardening and a regularized damage/fracture energy with an independent toughness parameter.
flow: Elastic-plastic fields and fracture calibration → coupled energy functional.

name: Irreversible incremental fracture evolution
meaning: Minimize the updated incremental functional subject to damage irreversibility and phase-field bounds.
flow: Energy functional and prior damage → admissible crack evolution.

name: Quantitative normalized validation error
latex:
\mathcal E_y=\left[\frac{1}{N_v}\sum_{i=1}^{N_v}
 \frac{(\widehat y_i-y_i)^2}{s_i^2+\epsilon}\right]^{1/2},
meaning: Compute a scale-normalized RMS prediction error over independent validation cases.
flow: Model predictions and observations → quantitative evidence for or against the bridge.
